name: create
description: Create (or replace) a named wall-clock alarm. It fires as an `alarms.onAlarm { name, scheduledMs }` event on every connected bridge; with no runtime connected the fire is queued (returned by the next alarms.list as `fired`) and the Nexus window is opened to boot one. Alarms persist in the profile prefs across a restart; one that came due while the browser was not running fires ONCE when the profile loads, a periodic one then resumes on its original grid. A missing `whenMs` with a `periodMs` means one period from now. At most 256 alarms. Returns { ok: true }. Additive capability: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED (and does not advertise `alarms`).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: 1 to 64 characters; an existing alarm by this name is replaced.

inputs.name: whenMs
inputs.description: First fire, wall-clock ms since the Unix epoch (Date.now()). A past time fires at once.

inputs.name: periodMs
inputs.description: Repeat interval in ms, at least 30000. Absent: a one-shot alarm.
